acceptance: Scoped cancel target stops only the current worktree's preflight, releases the lock and records a failed receipt, proven by a two-worktree test.
heavy-work.md forbids pattern kills of shared entry points (and AGENTS.md if the owner chooses).
Receipts written 2026-11-25 12:30-14:00 checked; any passed receipt without test steps reported.
description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-25, between about 13:00 and 13:30 local time, an agent clearing its own stuck preflight ran `pkill -f "make pr-preflight"`. The pattern matched every session's `make pr-preflight` on the host, so other sessions' preflights were killed. Nothing in docs/agent/heavy-work.md or the make targets offers a way to stop only the preflight started from one worktree, and nothing forbids pattern kills of shared entry points. Two open items make this worse: preflight-receipt-passes-when-killed-20261125 and preflight-receipt-passed-without-tests-on-termination-20261123 report that a killed preflight can write a passed receipt, so a killed run may have left a receipt that should not exist.

## Change
1. Add a make target that cancels only the preflight (and its host-lock wrapper and children) started from the current worktree, identified from the lock record or a per-worktree pid file, and records the receipt as failed.
2. Add a rule to docs/agent/heavy-work.md: never stop shared entry points with pattern kills (pkill -f, killall); use the scoped target.
3. Check the receipts written on 2026-11-25 between 12:30 and 14:00 for passed receipts without test steps, and report them.

## Decision gates
- G1: the owner decides whether the rule is also added to AGENTS.md (an authority file kept deliberately compact) or stays in heavy-work.md.
- G2: if the receipt fix in preflight-receipt-passes-when-killed-20261125 is not yet merged, the cancel target must still mark its receipt failed itself; do not depend on that item.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if: a test runs two preflight-shaped processes from different worktrees and shows the target stops only its own, releases the host lock, leaves the other running, and records a failed receipt; the docs rule is merged; the receipt check result is recorded in context.

## Guardrails
- Never move, delete or recreate the lock file; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force or BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off.
- The target never signals processes outside the current worktree's process tree.
- Write work: linked worktree, pinned human identity, no agent attribution, make pr-preflight, make pr-open, make pr-arm.
